articles.title: SBI Shinsei links bank deposits to crypto rewards in Japan: Nikkei
articles.snippet: SBI will give out vouchers that can be redeemed for Bitcoin, Ether or XRP through SBI VC Trade, linking bank savings with the group’s crypto exchange arm.

articles.title: Humanity Protocol Loses $36M After Private Keys 'Compromised,' Token Crashes 73%
articles.snippet: The decentralized identity protocol said a compromised employee's laptop let attackers seize its bridges and mint tokens at will.
